description: Open the architectural floor plan at '/home/ga/Documents/LibreCAD/floorplan.dxf' in LibreCAD. Add a new layer named 'Dimensions'. On that layer, add a horizontal linear dimension annotation that measures the full width of the outermost bounding box of the drawing from its leftmost point to its rightmost point. Place the dimension line below the drawing. Save the result to '/home/ga/Documents/LibreCAD/floorplan_dims.dxf'.
